Hey there, %PLAYERNAME%! I’m glad you’re here—something remarkable is happening in the area!
Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon are appearing in greater numbers than I’ve ever seen recorded.
And if we’re bold enough to venture into the action, I’m sure there will be tons for us to discover!
Wait, why am I still standing here gabbing? Let’s get out there and explore!
We stand at a THRILLING crossroads, %PLAYERNAME%!
This area is loaded with both Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon. I can’t decide which one is more fascinating—they both have so much charm!
You could blaze a trail to the future with a Steel-type Pokémon at your side…
But maybe the bold, daring power of Dragon types calls out to your adventurous spirit?
Which speaks to your heart, my friend? Steel or Dragon?
A bold and adventurous choice! There’s always something exciting to learn about Dragon-type Pokémon.
I’ll never forget the first time I encountered a wild Dragonite. I filled an entire notebook with research notes that day!
And every Dragon type I’ve studied since then has revealed something new and fascinating.
So keep your peepers peeled, my friend. For every tidbit we learn about Dragon types, there’s that much more still to be discovered.
Hey there, %PLAYERNAME%! I don’t doubt your bravery, but still, don’t let Dragon-type Pokémon intimidate you!
Getting to know one can be an incredibly rewarding experience, after all.
You just have to be daring enough to grow along with them!
Well done, %PLAYERNAME%! Now, let’s dive into the tactical considerations of Dragon-type Pokémon.
Dragon types are fearsome attackers, and they deal supereffective damage against other Dragon types.
If you’re facing other Dragon types, remember that Ice-, Fairy-, and other Dragon-type Pokémon can be particularly effective.
Powerful as they are, knowing their vulnerabilities is what separates a good Trainer from a great one.
In battle, as in all things, knowledge is power!
Outstanding job broadening your knowledge of Dragon-type Pokémon, %PLAYERNAME%!
But as always, there’s a final surprise—Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia have just appeared!
Only a Trainer with skills like yours could rise to this challenge.
Take heart—everything you’ve learned has been preparing you for this moment.
Head into battle with confidence and show them what you’re made of!
Phenomenal work, %PLAYERNAME%! You faced Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia and came out on top!
I couldn’t ask for a more dedicated Trainer to work with.
But this is just one chapter of a much bigger story. There are so many more Pokémon types to learn about!
I can’t wait to see where your journey takes you next, %PLAYERNAME%.
Steel-type Pokémon are an excellent choice!
Their remarkable resilience and steadfast nature never fail to impress me.
And the beauty of research is that every encounter has something new to teach us.
Why, one time I attempted to take a Metagross’s measurements during a battle, and…well, let’s just say it wasn’t my most graceful bit of research.
But I digress. Go on, spend some time with those remarkable Pokémon and let their resilience inspire you!
As you know, a Trainer’s bond with their Pokémon is one of the most powerful forces in the world!
And with Steel-type Pokémon, I bet you could form bonds as strong as...well, steel!
The more I study those Pokémon, the more they surprise me.
Take some time to grow with them, %PLAYERNAME%. Solid trust is built one interaction at a time.
Excellent work, %PLAYERNAME%. Now, let’s sharpen that Steel type knowledge even further!
Here’s a practical tip: Steel-type Pokémon resist an impressive array of types. This makes them practically a fortress unto themselves in battle!
But every fortress has its weak point—Fire-, Fighting-, and Ground-type Pokémon can make quick work of their defenses.
You might want to keep this info in your back pocket. It just might help you forge a path to victory in your next battle!
You’ve done some truly outstanding work honing your knowledge of Steel-type Pokémon, %PLAYERNAME%.
We can’t celebrate yet, though. First, we’ve got some legendary guests to attend to: Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia!
Only a Trainer with skills like yours could rise to this challenge!
Take heart—everything you’ve learned has been preparing you for this moment.
Go on now. Breathe deep, trust your training, and then get out there and show off your steely resolve!
Wow! %PLAYERNAME%, you’ve really proven yourself as an extraordinary Steel type Trainer!
Your dedication is as firm as...well, you get the idea!
It's been a thrill watching you grow throughout this adventure.
Ah, but the Pokémon world is vast, and there’s still so much more to explore.
And never forget that I’ll be here to cheer you on the whole way!
Happening now: Daring as Dragons Hour
Happening now: Solid as Steel Hour
%PLAYERNAME%! Excellent to see you, and great timing. Something extraordinary is afoot!
My peaceful morning stroll was interrupted by a towering figure moving in the distance—a thrilling mystery!
I’ve consulted my field notes and identified a few compelling candidates for who it could be, but I’ll need your sharp instincts to confirm my findings.
Follow the clues and see what you can uncover. Our mysterious friend has left quite the trail...
This is your moment, my friend! Let’s find that Pokémon!
What an incredible discovery! Based on what we’ve found, I’d say that was a Gigantamax Duraludon!
It’s a Steel and Dragon type, a remarkable combination shared by only a handful of discovered Pokémon.
And look where it’s led us, %PLAYERNAME%! This place is filled with both Steel and Dragon types!
To think that epic trail led us all the way here.
Well, let’s not keep these Pokémon waiting. Time to explore!
All the Steel-type Pokémon around sure are something to behold, aren’t they?
Sturdy, resilient, and sometimes even gleaming! Gosh, Steel-type Pokémon are truly fascinating.
And let me tell you, their “steely” resolve is an inspiration! I could use that kind of focus in the lab...
Anyhow, I’d like you to spend some time with them and observe their unique behaviors.
I have a feeling they’ll leave a strong impression on you, %PLAYERNAME%!
Dragon-type Pokémon tend to leave a trail of legends and wonder wherever they roam.
There’s just something inspiring about them, don’t you think?
And on that note, please spend some time getting closer to them. Let your curiosity guide you!
Those magnificent Dragon types have so many secrets to share with us. Let’s GO!
Brace yourself %PLAYERNAME%—Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia just showed up!
Finding Dialga and Palkia in the same place at the same time is extraordinary enough, but Dynamaxed too? It’s truly remarkable!
This sure is a BIG opportunity for us! Haha!
It’s time we put our knowledge to work and help calm them down.
I believe in you %PLAYERNAME%—go and show them what you’re made of!
What a journey this has been, %PLAYERNAME%. I’m in awe!
Chasing down that mysterious Pokémon has been quite the epic adventure. All in a day’s work though, right?
And your understanding of Steel and Dragon types has grown so much!
Ah, but the Pokémon world is vast, and there’s still so much more to explore!
How exciting is that?! Anyhow, onward, %PLAYERNAME%! Our greatest discoveries are still ahead of us!
Spooky surprises are appearing on the map!
